grok.verdict: Approved at 58 (up from 55): the throws and the optional fall and get-up clips are in and the feet now plant, but the rash guard shows ripple bands and a wide off-shoulder neckline, and the shorts are blotchy with ragged hems.

gemini.verdict: Approved: a far more natural face with the eyeliner and chest emblem gone, but it scores 26 because two claims are false (the manifest's skin/eye material values and the NOTES.md ripstop uniform with bronze-gold straps); correct the paperwork and give the suit real fabric detail.

hermes.verdict: Valid and fight-ready, but the renders show the camera inside a broken mesh, so there's almost nothing to judge. Fix the mesh and re-render.

claude.verdict: Self-submitted: passes every automated check. Realism awaits the owner's score. Entrant's note: Clothing fix: the sportsuit now takes the skin's own bone weights (nearest point on the body surface, barycentric blend) instead of MPFB's 17 coarse groups, set in fit_clothes_weights() in source/04_e

me.verdict: Brain-only update approved: the round-timer reset, step-in throw plan and hook/roundhouse finisher match the claims, and the unchanged fighter keeps its 38; the next points are in the neck seam, the rippled shirt and boxy shorts, and real hair.
